## Comprehension attestation

The accountable maintainer confirms:

- [ ] I can explain the invariants protected by this change.
- [ ] I can describe the main failure, cancellation, concurrency and rollback paths.
- [ ] I verified that no second identity model or mutable source of truth was introduced.
- [ ] I know which verification oracle is independent from the implementation.
- [ ] I reviewed dependency, permission, privacy and secret-handling impact.
- [ ] I can identify what remains unproven.
- [ ] I can diagnose and revert this change without relying on the generating agent.
- [ ] I can name two adversarial cases not proposed by the implementation agent.
- [ ] I verified required evidence was produced for the final merge commit, not an obsolete PR head.

Rollback command or exact procedure:

- [ ] single-maintainer reviewed
- [ ] two-party human reviewed
- [ ] external audit
